newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Six Albanians killed in gang warfare.
newsitem.headline: Six Albanians killed in gang warfare.

text.p: Six Albanians travelling in one vehicle were shot dead in the south of the Balkan nation on Monday in what appeared to be gang warfare, Albanian state news agency ATA reported.
The men were hit by a volley of machine-gun fire as their car entered a village near Kucove, 110 km (70 miles) south of the capital Tirana, it said.
No comment was immediately available from the Interior Ministry.
The south of Albania, Europe's most impoverished nation, has been a hotbed of violence since the collapse of bogus investment schemes unleashed widespread looting and lawlessness.
More than 1,500 people have been killed and some 10,000 injured.

An estimated one million weapons are still in private hands. Albanians have been given until September 30 to hand in all looted arms from military barracks or face a jail sentence of up to five years.
